research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Smule is researching methods for audiovisual collaboration with latency management, as described in titles such as 'Audiovisual collaboration method with latency management for wide-area' and 'Crowd-sourced device latency estimation for synchronization of recordings in distributed performances.' Their work includes systems for applying audio-visual effects based on musical structure, template-based excerpting and rendering of multimedia performances, and automated pitch correction and transformation of vocals. These areas encompass real-time group music creation, performance enhancement, and user collaboration.

overview_description.description:
Smule develops music-making apps that connect people. The company was founded to enable anyone to create, discover, love, and enjoy music. The company's products include AutoRap, Magic Piano, Guitar!, I Am T-Pain, Ocarina, and more.

Smule was established in 2008 and is based in San Francisco, California.
